---
name: Feature request
about: A new rule, chart, importer, guide or capability
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**The problem you want solved**
Who has it (developer, non-technical teammate, AI-assistant user) and when.

**What you would like PerfAgent to do**
Which screen (globe, deep dive, flow, charts, compare, guide, live, settings, CLI, MCP) and what it shows or does.

**Kind of change**

- [ ] New rule (which metric and area; what it detects; the fix; a code sample that should trigger it)
- [ ] New chart (the question it answers; which tab; the one-sentence takeaway)
- [ ] New importer (format, a sample file)
- [ ] New guide or guide change
- [ ] CLI / config option
- [ ] Other

**Does it fit the rules?**
Local only · read-only by default · the user's own AI and tokens · no telemetry. If the feature needs a server or a hosted service, say so; it may belong to the planned hosted edition.

**Feature ID**
If it matches a row in the feature inventory (`perfagent-build-rules.md`, section 2), name it (e.g. F20).
